predecessors.name: Zhaobaogou culture
predecessors.text: the Chifeng part of the Zhaobaogou country and the cells where the Zhaobaogou and Hongshan discs meet

successors.name: Xiaoheyan culture
successors.text: "the West Liao river basin in northeast China", "an area stretching from Inner Mongolia to Liaoning" (Hongshanhou in Chifeng, Niuheliang)

ledger.x: 4700 BCE: the Hongshan culture appears in the West Liao basin ("c.
4700 BCE: the Hongshan holds the Chifeng country of the Zhaobaogou, its ancestor culture; the pages give no hand-over date.

certainty.note: No border is recorded; the culture is known from ritual centres and graves.
